apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
New
- Albums show all their songs: an album you have only some songs of shows the rest too, greyed where they belong, each with Get, and Get the missing songs for all of them. It says whether it's an album, an EP or a single as its sources do (not guessed from how many songs are here).
- Songs Tuna filed itself go to Lidarr once it knows their album (after you turn on Deezer in Lidarr, or singles and EPs): Lidarr files them into the album with its names, and its cover if it writes covers (Settings → Metadata → Kodi/Emby → Album Images). Every few hours, and right away with Look again.

Changed
- Any source Lidarr knows albums from (Deezer, Discogs… through Tubifarry's MetaMix) works in Tuna the same way: Tuna asks Lidarr for the artist and the cover rather than each source.

Fixed
- Songs that had arrived still showed as not here in playlists when the library names them a little differently: now the same artist's song with nearly the same title counts.

To update: the server (pull the new image). The apps need nothing new.
